name: @gino/host-proxy
description: Gino host LLM credential proxy — provider detection, model map, credential store, Claude<->OpenAI translator and HTTP forward path. The raw Codex WS relay is Bun-only behind ./bun; the /llm Hono router (Bun-only, WS bridge) behind ./hono.

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm --packages external && bun build src/bun.ts --outdir dist --target bun --format esm --packages external && bun build src/hono.ts --outdir dist --target bun --format esm --packages external && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
